tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_hermiticity

assertions.expected: Fermionic expressions with paired adjoints are Hermitian and unpaired ones are not.

tests.rationale: The test includes duplicate/reduced ladder terms; its truth values depend on fermionic adjoints.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/spin_operator_hermiticity

assertions.expected: Spin expressions have the expected Hermiticity truth values.

tests.rationale: The spin operator adjoint relation determines the selected predicate.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/vibrational_operator_hermiticity

assertions.expected: Vibrational ladder expressions with balanced conjugates are Hermitian.

tests.rationale: The test deliberately includes duplicate ladder terms, so reduction and adjoint semantics matter.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/fermionic_operator_algebra

assertions.expected: Fermionic reduction combines duplicate ladder terms to the expected operator.

tests.rationale: The retained reduction test checks operator simplification.

tests.label: general_semantics/symbolic_operator_arithmetic

assertions.expected: Adding two operator term containers gives the expected coefficients.

tests.rationale: The selected addition test does not exercise anticommuting product or adjoint rules.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/spin_operator_algebra

assertions.expected: SpinOp reduction expands a spin ladder term into X, Y and Z-square terms.

tests.rationale: Although simpler subcases aggregate coefficients, the ladder-operator expansion makes the spin algebra primary.

tests.label: quantum_semantics/spin_operator_algebra

assertions.expected: Spin ladder +- expands to the expected XX, XY, YX and YY terms.

tests.rationale: The complex coefficients encode the spin ladder convention.

tests.label: interface/operator_label_parsing

assertions.expected: Vibrational plus/minus label input produces the expected exposed term list.

tests.rationale: The selected constructor/parsing test checks public label representation.

tests.label: general_semantics/symbolic_operator_arithmetic

assertions.expected: Adding a vibrational operator to itself doubles its coefficients.

tests.rationale: The selected addition check is coefficient aggregation without a ladder-product identity.

rationale: Reviewed all three Hermiticity cases and six retained operator tests; the spin reduction case includes an explicit ladder expansion that decides its quantum label.
